name: Compact Studio
tagline: A 32 m² lock-up with a sleeping nook and galley kitchen.
description: A tightly planned studio for one person or a couple. The open living-sleep zone faces the longest wall of windows, while a galley kitchen and bathroom sit as a service strip. Furniture has to earn its place: a sofa-bed or platform bed, a compact dining table, and storage that doubles as a room divider.

rooms.name: Living & sleep
rooms.purpose: Daytime living and a queen or sofa-bed along the inner wall.

rooms.name: Kitchenette
rooms.purpose: Two-burner cooktop, fridge, and 2.2 m of worktop.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.purpose: Shower, basin, and WC packed into a wet room.

name: Garden Studio
tagline: A 40 m² studio with a dining bay and outdoor threshold.
description: Slightly larger than a lock-up studio, this plan adds a distinct dining bay and a utility cupboard. The living zone can hold a proper sofa and a separate bed without blocking circulation. Best when a courtyard or balcony sits on the long elevation.

rooms.name: Living
rooms.purpose: Sofa, media, and a reading chair facing the garden door.

rooms.name: Sleep & dining
rooms.purpose: Bed or sofa-bed plus a four-person table.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.purpose: L-shaped kitchen with fridge and pantry cupboard.

name: One-Bedroom City Flat
tagline: A 48 m² apartment with a private bedroom and open kitchen.
description: A classic one-bedroom plan: private sleep, a combined living-kitchen, and a bathroom off the entry. The living room is large enough for a three-seat sofa and a small dining table. The bedroom takes a queen bed with two nightstands if the wardrobe is kept to 1.2 m.

rooms.name: Living & kitchen
rooms.purpose: Open-plan living with a kitchen run along one wall.

rooms.name: Bedroom
rooms.purpose: Queen bed, wardrobe, and a desk if needed.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.purpose: Full bath with shower over tub or a generous shower.

name: One-Bedroom Courtyard Home
tagline: A 58 m² home with a study nook and indoor-outdoor living.
description: Built around a small courtyard or patio. The living room is deeper, a study nook sits off the entry, and the kitchen is a proper U-shape rather than a single run. Suitable as a first home or a downsizer when outdoor space matters as much as interior area.

rooms.name: Living
rooms.purpose: Deep living room opening to a patio.

rooms.name: Kitchen & dining
rooms.purpose: U-kitchen with a four-to-six seat table.

name: Two-Bedroom Family Cottage
tagline: A 75 m² cottage with a second bedroom that can be a nursery or guest room.
description: A practical family starter: living at the front, kitchen-dining in the middle, bedrooms and bath at the quiet end. The second bedroom fits a single bed or a cot and a small wardrobe. Circulation is a short hall rather than rooms opening through each other.

rooms.name: Living
rooms.purpose: Family living with space for a sofa and play.

rooms.name: Second bedroom
rooms.purpose: Single or twin, nursery, or office.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.purpose: Family bathroom with bath and separate WC if preferred.

name: Two-Bedroom Open Plan
tagline: An 85 m² plan with a wide living-kitchen and two equal bedrooms.
description: Favoured in newer apartments: a wide open living-kitchen, a utility cupboard, and two similar bedrooms so neither feels like a leftover. The living span can take a dining table without crowding the sofa. A second bathroom is optional if you split the wet area later.

rooms.name: Living, kitchen & dining
rooms.purpose: Open social room spanning the front of the home.

name: Three-Bedroom Family Home
tagline: A 120 m² family house with a lounge, kitchen-diner, and three bedrooms.
description: A conventional family arrangement: public rooms together, bedrooms grouped, and a utility off the kitchen. The lounge can be quieter than the kitchen-diner. The third bedroom works as a child room or a dedicated office. Quantities on this plan are a useful starting point for a whole-house refresh.

rooms.name: Kitchen & dining
rooms.purpose: Family kitchen with dining table and island option.

name: Four-Bedroom Villa Layout
tagline: A 160 m² villa-style plan with a formal lounge, family kitchen, and four bedrooms.
description: A larger household layout for comparing finishes across many rooms. Public rooms sit on the garden side; bedrooms occupy a quieter wing. Use this plan to test a whole-house palette — flooring through the social rooms, paint schedules per bedroom, and a realistic tile count for two bathrooms. Always have a professional review any structural or services work.

rooms.name: Main bedroom
rooms.purpose: Main suite with space for seating.
